description: Consolidate all findings into ordered implementation plan with file paths, test strategy, dependency chains, and Sol authorization gates, identifying compatible source corrections vs. missing authority requiring concrete design recommendations
steps: Read all previous FEAT findings: ownership-classification.md, schema-changes.md, service-changes.md, migration-plan.md

Identify compatible corrections (no schema migration required): (1) Enhanced OwnershipContext TypeScript interface in packages/auth/src/rbac/ownership.service.ts (add tenantId field, update hasPermissionOrOwnership logic), (2) Token extraction enhancement in API routes to get tenantId from JWT brand claim, (3) Unit tests for tenant-qualified ownership checks (new test file packages/auth/src/rbac/__tests__/tenant-ownership.test.ts following existing ownership.service.test.ts pattern), (4) Documentation updates in architecture files

Identify missing authority requiring Sol decision: (1) Schema migration execution (ADD COLUMN tenantId - requires reviewed migration and authorization), (2) Historical data tenant assignment (categories 3/4 quarantine - requires review criteria), (3) Brand-to-tenant mapping service (create new tenant table vs. use platform enum directly), (4) Multi-database coordination (if tenantId lives in db-people but progress in db-tutorial, how to enforce FK?), (5) Export job schema location (if export_jobs table not found, needs discovery and design)

Build implementation dependency chain: Phase 1 (no schema changes): TypeScript interface updates, token extraction logic, unit tests, documentation. Phase 2 (requires Sol authorization): Schema migration DDL review and approval, migration script development, staging environment test, quarantine review process. Phase 3 (post-migration): Repository signature updates, service propagation changes, integration tests, rollback procedure test. Phase 4 (final): Production migration execution (separate authorization), post-migration verification, monitoring

Design test strategy: (1) Unit tests for OwnershipRBACService with tenant context (expect tenant mismatch to deny even if userId matches), (2) Integration tests for export download route with tenant checks (extend apps/api-server/src/app/api/export/download/__tests__/batch-08-ownership.test.ts with tenant collision scenarios), (3) Repository tests for progress with tenantId WHERE clauses (packages/db-tutorial/src/repositories/__tests__/ following existing test patterns), (4) Migration script tests on cloned staging data (verify category assignments, quarantine counts, rollback restoration)

List exact file paths per phase: Phase 1: packages/auth/src/rbac/ownership.service.ts (OwnershipContext interface), packages/auth/src/rbac/__tests__/tenant-ownership.test.ts (new), apps/api-server/src/app/api/export/download/route.ts (tenantId extraction), audit/FND03_Ownership_Architecture_Decision.md (new documentation). Phase 2: packages/db-tutorial/src/schema/tutorial-progress.ts (schema), packages/db-skillup/src/schema/users.ts (schema), migrations/*.sql (DDL), scripts/migrate-tenant-ownership.ts (migration script). Phase 3: packages/db-tutorial/src/repositories/tutorial-progress.repository.ts (signatures), packages/auth/src/session.service.ts (tenantId in session), apps/api-server/src/app/api/export/download/__tests__/batch-08-ownership.test.ts (tenant tests). Phase 4: deployment runbook, rollback script, monitoring queries

Document Sol authorization gates: Gate 1 (after Phase 1): Review enhanced OwnershipContext and token extraction logic. Approve Phase 2 schema changes or request redesign. Gate 2 (after Phase 2 staging test): Review migration script results on staging clone. Approve category assignments and quarantine decisions. Authorize production migration or require changes. Gate 3 (after Phase 3): Review integration test results. Authorize Phase 4 production execution. Gate 4 (post-migration): Review verification queries and monitoring. Accept FND03 completion or require remediation

Build concrete design recommendations for missing authority: Recommendation 1 (tenant table design): 'Create packages/db-people/src/schema/tenants.ts with columns: id (uuid PK), name (text UNIQUE NOT NULL), platform (platformEnum NOT NULL UNIQUE), createdAt. Map JWT brand claim → tenant via platform column. FK from users.tenantId → tenants.id enforces referential integrity. Alternative: use brand/platform enum directly as tenantId text without FK (simpler but no referential integrity).' Recommendation 2 (export job schema): 'If export_jobs table not found, it may be background_jobs or report_jobs in packages/db/src/schema/. Verify with: grep -r export.*job packages/db/. Add tenantId column to discovered table. If jobs span multiple schemas, recommend consolidated jobs table in db-people as canonical source.' Recommendation 3 (quarantine review): 'Establish quarantine review SOP: weekly review of tutorial_progress_quarantine, match orphaned userId against historical logs, restore rows with confirmed provenance, permanently delete rows older than 90 days without provenance. Owner: data governance team. Tool: SQL queries + manual log inspection (no automated guessing).'

Write final implementation plan at .agents/tasks/fnd03-ownership-architecture/implementation-plan.md with: Executive Summary (FND03 scope and deliverables), Implementation Phases (1-4 with exact file paths), Dependency Chain (blocked-by relationships), Test Strategy (unit/integration/migration tests), Sol Authorization Gates (4 gates with decision criteria), Compatible Corrections (can implement now), Missing Authority Items (require Sol decision with concrete recommendations), Verification Commands (pnpm test, grep queries, migration verification SQL), Rollback Procedures, Monitoring Queries
acceptance_criteria: implementation-plan.md contains 4 implementation phases with exact file paths
Compatible corrections identified: OwnershipContext TypeScript changes, token extraction, unit tests
Missing authority items identified: schema migration execution, tenant assignment, brand-to-tenant mapping, quarantine criteria
Concrete design recommendations provided for each missing authority item (not 'TBD' or 'Sol to decide')
Sol authorization gates documented with decision criteria at each phase boundary
Test strategy covers unit tests, integration tests, migration script tests on staging clone
verification: grep 'Phase [1-4]' implementation-plan.md | wc -l (expect 4+ matches for 4 phases)
grep 'Gate [1-4]\|Sol authorization' implementation-plan.md (expect authorization gates documented)
grep 'Recommendation [1-3]' implementation-plan.md (expect concrete design recommendations for missing authority)
